title: Hydrogen breath test (SIBO, lactose)
what: You drink a sweet solution and blow into a device every 15 to 30 minutes. The gases in your breath show how your bowel digests sugars.
why: For bloating, pain, or diarrhea after meals. To check for too many bacteria in the small bowel, called SIBO, or for lactose intolerance.
duration: usually 2 to 3 hours; results are given right away or in a few days
tell_doctor: If you took antibiotics in the past month
If you recently had a colonoscopy
What medicines you take, especially laxatives and heartburn medicines

prepare.title: Diet the day before
prepare.text: Usually for 24 hours: no beans, dairy, sweets, fruit, or flour foods. Most often allowed: rice, meat, fish, and eggs. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Fasting
prepare.text: Usually 10 to 12 hours without food. Water is fine.

prepare.title: In the morning
prepare.text: Do not smoke, chew gum, or drink coffee. Brush your teeth.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: You are sometimes asked to skip some medicines before the test. Do not stop anything on your own. Ask your doctor.

bring: A book or phone. There is a lot of waiting
steps: First, you breathe out into the device. This is your starting level
Every 15 to 30 minutes, you blow into the device again
You sit quietly at the clinic the whole time
You are told when the test is over
feel: During the test, you may get bloating, rumbling, or loose stool. This is part of the answer
after: You can eat after the test
Bloating usually passes within the day
Your doctor will explain the result

faq.q: Can I drink water during the test?
faq.a: Most often, a little plain water is fine. Check with the clinic.
Smoking changes your breath, and the result will be wrong.

reminders.text: Hydrogen breath test tomorrow. Today, eat only allowed foods, and have dinner early. Do not smoke or eat in the morning.
